Reproduction and data dictionary

Source: vignettes/reproduction.Rmd
reproduction.Rmd

Reproducing the analyses

The AdaReFun repository contains the package and simulation and data-analysis scripts. Follow the replication README for setup, saved-result checks, report generation, and numerical reruns. It records the package versions used in the study, including FMCP 0.2.0 and the regional fitting code.

Input dictionary

Input Meaning
y Numeric scalar response, one per curve
x Numeric matrix: rows are observations, columns are common argument locations
argvals Strictly increasing locations in physical or declared normalized units
validationy/validationy / validationx Independent response/vector and curve/matrix with the same grid
lambda / kappa Explicit penalty and roughness tuning grids

Training centering is performed by the package; scaling beyond this is an analysis choice. Missing or infinite values are rejected, not imputed.

Article datasets

Truck: 108 distributed rows, 90 acceleration measurements on seconds 1–90, particulate-emission response, distributed with PFLR 1.1.0. No vehicle grouping identifier is available. NeoSpectra: 1,974 soil-sample IDs and 601 reflectance measurements on 1350–2550 nm, response log(1 + SOC percent). Repeat spectra were averaged within sample before analysis. Their data sources and licenses remain separate from the AdaReFun software license.

Seeds and preprocessing are specified in the run scripts. Folds and comparison predictions can be generated locally, or imported from an existing study after checking the recorded file hashes. The run guide describes both routes; no data or prediction files are bundled in the repository.

Validation scope

Unit tests cover MCP/SCAD and adaptive regional fits, validation selection, predictions, input checks, and agreement with the study code.
